property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir
property.description: MASTER ONLY in practice. Holds fsimage + edit log.

property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: Block storage. Under WSL2 keep this on the Linux filesystem, never on a /mnt/c path: the 9p mount is slow and does not give HDFS the file semantics it expects.

property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Three copies of every block across five nodes. With commodity laptops that sleep and disconnect, 3 is the lowest value that still tolerates two simultaneous absences.

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: 128 MiB. This is the property that decides map-task count: an input file of 244 MiB becomes 2 blocks, therefore 2 splits, therefore 2 map tasks. Worth knowing before wondering why only two workers are busy.

property.name: dfs.namenode.datanode.registration.ip-hostname-check
property.description: DataNodes register by IP. On a mesh network the reverse lookup of a mesh address does not necessarily match the forward one, and this check would reject an otherwise healthy DataNode over that mismatch.
